Harvest Moon 3D - A New Beginning.name: Harvest Moon: A New Beginning
Harvest Moon 3D - A New Beginning.summary: Harvest Moon: A New Beginning is a farming simulation game for the Nintendo 3DS video game console. As the new farmer in town, it is your job to use your farm and its resources to revitalize a once-popular town. You can grow crops and raise animals, as well as interact with villagers and possibly get married.
